landing.title: Vinko — social prediction pool with virtual points
landing.h1: The classic pool, with your friends and without money.
landing.sub: Vinko is a social prediction network: create a pool about anything, share it on WhatsApp and compete with virtual points. Vinkos can't be bought or exchanged for money.
landing.step.create: Create your pool in under 30 seconds: a question and its options.
landing.step.share: Share it on WhatsApp and your friends join from the link.
landing.step.pick: Everyone picks an option and stakes the Vinkos they want.
landing.step.resolve: When the result is known, the creator resolves it and the Vinkos are shared out.
landing.points: Vinkos are virtual points: earned by playing, inviting friends or watching ads. They can't be bought with money, can't be exchanged for money and aren't transferable.
landing.age: Minimum registration age: 14. Some features are limited to over-18s. We check age by asking for your year of birth; it is not identity verification.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.s1.b: Vinko (vinko.fun) is the controller of your data. For any privacy query or to exercise your rights, write to hola@vinko.fun.
legal.privacy.s2.b: When you create your account we store your email and, if you sign in with Google, your name and profile photo. We store the birth year you declare to apply the age limitation. We record your activity in the app (pools created, entries, Vinkos) to provide the service.
legal.privacy.s3.b: We use our own cookies necessary to keep your session. We show advertising through Google AdSense, which may use cookies and similar technologies to serve ads based on your visits to this and other sites. Google and its partners may process data as third-party vendors. You can manage ad personalization at adssettings.google.com and see how Google uses data at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.
legal.privacy.s4.b: We use PostHog (EU servers) to measure aggregate usage and Sentry to detect errors. This data helps us improve the product and is processed with data minimization.
legal.privacy.s5.b: We process your data to provide the service (contract performance), with your consent (analytics and non-essential advertising) and on legitimate interest (security). We keep data while you have an account and as long as needed to meet legal obligations.
legal.privacy.s6.b: You can access, rectify, erase, restrict or object to the processing of your data and request portability by writing to hola@vinko.fun. You may also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
legal.privacy.s7.b: The minimum age to register is 14. Some features are limited to over-18s. We indicate +18 by asking for the birth year; it is not an identity check, it is a known limitation of this phase.
legal.privacy.s8.b: We may update this policy. We will publish the current version on this page with its update date.
legal.terms.title: Terms and conditions
legal.terms.s1.b: Vinko is a social prediction network (social pools) where you compete with other people using virtual points (Vinkos). It is an entertainment service.
legal.terms.s2.b: Vinkos are virtual points with no monetary value. They cannot be bought with money, cannot be redeemed for money and are not transferable. They are earned by playing, inviting friends or watching rewarded ads, with daily limits.
legal.terms.s3.b: You are responsible for your account activity. You must be at least 14 to register; certain features require being over 18. You declare your birth year on entry.
legal.terms.s4.b: Illegal, violent, sexual, hateful content or content that puts minors at risk is not allowed. We moderate content and may take down pools or accounts that break these rules.
legal.terms.s5.b: Vinko's public layer runs only on virtual points. Prizes are awarded by accuracy ranking, never at random. Vinko does not hold users' money.
legal.terms.s6.b: The service is provided "as is" during this alpha phase. We may change or discontinue features and update these terms; we will publish the current version on this page.

admin.mx.sub: Everything comes from real tables through admin RPCs (kpi_*). Templates always excluded; editorial excluded from creator metrics. n=0 shows as 0; nothing is padded or estimated.
admin.mx.pending: Migration supabase/migrations/0033_metrics.sql is not applied yet. Retention, funnel, virality and economy appear once it is; the counts above are already real.
admin.mx.retNote: "—" = cohort under 5 people, or that has not reached that day yet. D-N = did something exactly N days after signup (calendar day, Madrid time). In brackets: active / people who could already be measured.
admin.mx.f.invitee: Came invited and made a pick
admin.mx.pppHint: median {m} · {p} pools with participants out of {t}
admin.mx.ttsHint: creator sharing their own pool · n={n}
admin.mx.e.creator: Creator loop
admin.mx.notRecon: There is no Vinkos ledger. Not reconstructible and therefore absent: daily bonus, 4-hour drip, streak milestones and the historic signup amount. "rows" = sum of stored amounts; "rule" = real rows × current rule (signup per config, share 50, invitation 200+200 with daily cap and milestones, creator loop 25 up to 20 per pool, parimutuel payout). Payout windows use resolved_at, which exists since 0033.
admin.mx.def.active: Active on day D: made a pick, answered the daily pick, created a pool, shared with reward, collected an ad reward or the daily bonus (last day only). The database has no session log.
admin.mx.def.dau: DAU / WAU / MAU: people active that day / in the previous 7 / 30 days including the day. DAU/MAU = stickiness.
admin.mx.def.ret: Retention D1/D7/D30: % of the cohort active exactly 1/7/30 days after signup, only among those who already reached that day. Cohorts under 5 people show as "—".
admin.mx.def.funnel: Funnel: % over signups; medians in hours from signup to first pick or first pool. Repeat = 2nd user pool within 7 days of the 1st.
admin.mx.def.k: K-factor: validated invitees (came through a link and already made their first pick) divided by users. The link carries the handle, not the pool: there is no invitee→pool attribution.
admin.mx.def.ppp: Participants per pool: people other than the creator with a pick in each user pool (source=user; editorial and templates excluded).
admin.mx.def.tts: Time to share: hours from a creator publishing a pool to their first rewarded share of it.
admin.mx.def.clickjoin: Click → signup: not computed here. Needs web analytics (GA4 / PostHog) with consent.
admin.mx.def.economy: Economy: Vinkos are virtual points; they are never bought or exchanged for money. Faucets create Vinkos; sinks remove them; refunds and payouts only move what was already put in.
admin.mx.def.excl: Admin accounts: with "Exclude admin accounts" the team is left out of every count.
